items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 6 vs CAR along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley. Dameon Pierce expected to lead depleted PHI backfield behind Tanner McKee.
items.why: Missed all week of practice with hamstring; Shipley to IR.
items.implication: Pierce leads RB committee; McKee starts at QB with healthy top pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Dameon Pierce volume spike; DeVonta Smith/Goedert/Wicks elevated in McKee offense

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for third straight game vs NE; AD Mitchell also OUT. Braelon Allen shoulders Jets backfield load.
items.implication: Allen lead back again; Hall week-to-week for Week 7.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday at CLE due to ankle; will miss second straight game. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Huntley QB; Flowers remains WR2 viable, Andrews muted.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers target share; Isaiah Likely/Mark Andrews checkdowns

items.text: AJ Brown questionable; practiced all week limited (earlier than expected). Patriots also tried out RBs amid Henderson ankle uncertainty.
items.why: Limited practice all week on ankle; high-ankle for Henderson but practiced, possible Thursday focus.
items.implication: Game-time for Brown; Henderson may be managed.
items.opportunity: If Brown IN, WR1 usage; if Henderson limited, other NE backs

items.text: Unclear on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder) Qs. Tyler Warren Friday groin add as Q. Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so 2-WR Metcalf+Bernard sets. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Practice reports and designations; Friday adds and team WR depth.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; Metcalf target spike in 2-WR; McKee pass-catchers safer than RBs.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf routes/targets up; DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks in PHI air attack

items.text: IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr. (vs Texans). Multiple prior Qs removed from report.
items.why: Full practice or no designation after prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Full roles restored; McConkey no designation confirmed by Schefter.
items.opportunity: Standard usage resumes for cleared stars

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin); Baker Mayfield OUT (thumb, Jalon Daniels starts); Rashee Rice OUT. Multiple other OUT/Q listed comprehensively.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; KC WR thins; TB QB Daniels again.
items.opportunity: Other HOU RBs; KC remaining WRs/Kelce; TB skill upside with Daniels

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren added as questionable Friday after groin injury in individual drills.
items.implication: Monitor for game-time; IND TE depth thins if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, other IND pass-catchers (Pittman/Downs/Pierce) up

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs LAR.
items.opportunity: Other ARI RBs or pass-game pivot

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass-catchers. Also loves Drake London (WR6), George Kittle (TE3) in same theme.
items.why: WSH defense nightmare for WR/TE; London/Golden bankable usage.
items.implication: Start with confidence in soft matchups.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone upside vs leaky secondary

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume vs leaky run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line.
items.why: Volume + defenses leaking vs run; goal-line role for Javonte.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA) and Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT) due to ugly matchups and shaky QB situations; also Kyle Pitts (TE18).
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better spots.

items.text: Loves Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), Matthew Stafford (QB4 vs ARI), Jordan Love (QB5 vs DAL) in high-scoring games vs poor pass defenses. Notes Hurts OUT/McKee start and Caleb full practice.
items.why: Game environments and defenses that can't stop pass.
items.implication: Stream/start these QBs; fade Hurts managers to McKee cautiously.

items.text: Hates Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA toughest pass D) and Justin Herbert (QB25 @ KC lowest team total, scoring rut).
items.why: Elite pass defense for Nix; low total/rut for Herbert.
